title: Hangul IME Relay architecture and sync pattern
desc: HangulImeRelay WH_KEYBOARD_LL hook: architecture, bugs fixed 2026-05-08 (forced Korean on install), system-IME sync via ImmGetConversionStatus.
steps:
Architecture: WH_KEYBOARD_LL hook intercepts keystrokes when Korean mode ON. Composes via ImeProxy (system IME window) or HangulComposer FSM fallback. Toggle: Right Alt (VK_RMENU) or VK_HANGUL (0x15). Bypass: passes through when foreground window has working system IME (e.g. non-ConPTY windows).
Files: HangulImeRelay.cs (_koreanMode flag + hook), .Composer.cs (syllable FSM), .ImeProxy.cs (proxy window), .Inject.cs (injection), ImeRelayDaemon.cs (lifecycle).
BUG 2026-05-08: _koreanMode hardcoded true on install -- fixed to call IsSystemImeKoreanMode() instead.
BUG 2026-05-08: CreateImeProxy() forced ImmSetOpenStatus(true)+ImmSetConversionStatus(1,0) -- fixed to sync from system state.
IsSystemImeKoreanMode() reads ImmGetContext(GetForegroundWindow()) then ImmGetOpenStatus()+ImmGetConversionStatus(). IME_CMODE_NATIVE=1 means Hangul active. Returns false on any failure (safe English default).
Right Alt handler flips _koreanMode AND passes key to OS to keep relay and system IME in sync.
